content: Work is love made visible. And if you cannot work with love but only with distaste, it is better that you should leave your work and sit at the gate of the temple and take alms of those who work with joy.
author: Kahlil Gibran
explanation: Work is not a chore or punishment; it is the tangible embodiment of our spirit entering the material world. When we labor with resentment, we poison the bread we bake; when we labor with love, we participate in cosmic creation.
practicalInsight: Infuse whatever humble chore or project you tackle today with conscious craftsmanship and love for those who will benefit from it.
reflectionPrompt: Is your daily work an expression of love made visible, or are you performing it with lingering bitterness?
